_comment: The tower: Ryan's hand-modelled TowerRock with his cap DELETED, his open boundary loop EXTRUDED upward ring by ring with per-vertex noise so every new face inherits his faceting, then hollowed and windowed with EXACT boolean differences (use_self + use_hole_tolerant, without which the solver eats the whole rock). One continuous silhouette -- no cap, no band, no ledge. ORIGIN IS THE ROOM'S FLOOR: the guard stands at local y=0.17, the rock hangs to about y=-37, the crown tops out near +9.3. One textured material (packed 128x128 atlas), one UV set, no skin, no animation. TowerCollision rides in the .glb as a `-colonly` node: Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and discards its mesh, which is why `surfaces` is still 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn. If TowerCollision ever stops appearing, the guard will fall through the floor.
